parameters.query:
SELECT id, tracking_id, priority, created_at, assigned_to
FROM grievances
WHERE status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'INVESTIGATING')
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '72 hours';

=UPDATE grievances
SET status = 'ESCALATED',
    priority = 'CRITICAL',
    assigned_to = 'admin.registrar'
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};

INSERT INTO grievance_events (grievance_id, event_type, notes, actor, created_at)
VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, 'SLA_BREACH_ESCALATION', 'Autonomous SLA breach triggered by Cron Engine. Escalated to Registrar & Vice-Chancellor.', 'SLA_WATCHDOG_ENGINE', NOW());
